title: Global GDP Growth Rate
subtitle: Annual % change — 2015 to 2024
report: Global GDP contracted sharply in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic, recording a −3.1% decline — the worst since the Great Depression. The subsequent 2021 rebound of 6.0% was driven by pent-up demand, fiscal stimulus, and vaccine rollouts.
insights: The pandemic caused a larger GDP shock than the 2008 financial crisis.
2021's 6% bounce was the fastest global recovery in post-war history.
India and China together accounted for over 40% of global growth in 2023.

title: AI Market Size
subtitle: Global revenue in USD billions — 2020 to 2024
report: The AI market has experienced explosive growth, driven primarily by generative AI adoption following the launch of ChatGPT in late 2022. Enterprise software, cloud AI services, and hardware (particularly GPUs) have seen the highest spend.
insights: ChatGPT's launch triggered a 3x acceleration in enterprise AI adoption.
NVIDIA's GPU business grew 200%+ YoY in 2023–24.
Healthcare and finance are the top two industries by AI spend.

title: IPL TV Viewership
subtitle: Total viewers in millions per season
report: IPL viewership has grown consistently, making it the most-watched cricket league globally. The 2022 expansion to 10 teams and JioCinema's free-streaming deal drove a massive spike in digital viewership.
insights: JioCinema's free streaming in 2023 added 300M+ digital viewers.
The IPL brand value crossed $10 billion in 2024.
Women's IPL debuted in 2023 with 50M+ viewers in its first season.

title: Infertility Rates Are Rising
subtitle: Global prevalence and age-related fertility decline
report: Infertility is becoming a major global health issue, affecting approximately one in six adults worldwide. Female age remains the strongest predictor of fertility outcomes, with a gradual decline beginning around age 27 and a more significant reduction after age 35. Medical experts recommend seeking fertility evaluation after one year of unsuccessful attempts for individuals under 35, or after six months for those aged 35 and older. Early diagnosis and treatment can improve reproductive outcomes. [[https://www.inviafertility.com/blog/infertility-rates-are-rising-should-i-be-worried?utm_source=chatgpt.com]]
insights: Female fertility gradually declines after age 27
Chance of conception drops significantly after age 35
Seek specialist help after 12 months (<35 years)
Seek help after 6 months if age is 35 or older
